text:
Caleb Sefa Bansah
Please keep it respectful, especially towards Anja and all AIC's volunteers who volunteer their time to help you and other users. 
Your comment was at best laconic and incomplete, implying that her partner could enter Israel without a problem after their visa expired while they were abroad. This is simply not true and misleading, and could also lead to a loss of significant funds if they were to purchase a flight and then be denied boarding. 
Be Responsible With Your Content 
Be Respectful and Kind
